propositions: The reconciler bridge cron schedule must be doubled from 20-minute to 40-minute cadence using three cron entries that fire uniformly every 40 minutes over a 2-hour cycle.

The opt-in continuous reconciler chain must pace re-dispatches by sleeping for the duration of the previous pass before dispatching the next one, with a 900-second cap and skip threshold at 1800 seconds elapsed.
The reconciler bridge canary schedule must be doubled from hourly to 2-hourly, and its staleness alert window must double from 2 to 4 hours to maintain 3x cadence margin.
The pacing mechanism must remain skipped when PASS_STARTED_EPOCH is unset or non-numeric, and must not require a new repository Variable.
All references to the old cadence (*/20 cron syntax, hourly schedule, 2-hour window) in code comments and documentation must be updated to reflect the new doubled values.

Tests must assert that consecutive fire-time gaps in the three-entry cron schedule are uniformly 40 minutes, and must cover pacing branches for short elapsed times, elapsed-skip threshold, and missing environment variable.
